ModMetaData.name: UESDdebuger - UnityExplorer + SDB Debug
ModMetaData.author: UESDdebuger
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld debug toolkit: in-game UnityExplorer (F7) for inspecting objects, running C# and hooking methods, a local MCP server exposing 191 tools (process control, log reading, quick test map, C#/Hook, colony and map data queries, DebugAction, zone/selection, camera and video stream, map coordinate markers, long-running profiling tasks) that lets AI clients drive the game, and a Mono SDB code-level debugger with 20 tools (breakpoints, call stack, locals, stepping, eval, object inspection). 调试工具链模组：游戏内 UnityExplorer（F7 检视对象、执行 C#、Hook 方法）+ 本地 MCP 服务器（191 个工具：进程控制、读日志、快速进测试地图、C#/Hook、殖民地与地图数据查询、DebugAction、区域/选中、相机与视频流、地图坐标光标、长任务性能采样），让 AI 客户端直接驱动游戏 + Mono SDB 代码级调试器（20 个工具：断点、调用栈、局部变量、单步、求值、对象检查）。 Portions of the materials used to create this content/mod are trademarks and/or copyrighted works of Ludeon Studios Inc.
